text: Shipped as v0.114.0 (one update): Engine is now the home tab and Claude (Chat + Messages) its own tab; all Share-with-Claude buttons are gone; trash can per message and Clear all; a thumbs-up appears under your message once a Claude session has read it; you can attach screenshots/files in the chat (stored on a GitHub branch and deleted after 24 h unless Claude flags them). Auto-bet and CNO are no longer in the tab bar; Settings still opens them. Please try the Install update button on this one.
